platformAvailable.description:
Whether this channel can publish right now. `false` means it is switched off server-side — the channel itself is healthy, but its scheduled posts are being held.

Resolved for THIS channel: the `PLATFORM_<NAME>` flag narrowed by any variant flag matching its `accountType`. LinkedIn company pages (`accountType: "organization"`) are gated separately from personal profiles, so two LinkedIn channels in the same response can differ here.

- `on` — fully available.
- `connect_off` — new channels cannot be connected, but channels already connected keep publishing normally (used while a platform app review is pending).
- `off` — kill switch: the platform is unavailable, and posts targeting it are **held**, not failed. They publish automatically once the platform is switched back on.

A variant is never more permissive than its parent: `state: "off"` on the platform means every variant is off too.

PlatformSpecific.description: Per-platform options. Keys are platform names. Facebook: { shareToStory, thumbnailUrl, textFormatPresetId }. thumbnailUrl is the cover for a video or Reel; it is applied to the video after it publishes, so it lands a moment after the post, and a cover that cannot be fetched or is rejected leaves the video published with Facebook's own chosen frame rather than failing the post. textFormatPresetId (string of digits, a Facebook background ID; anything else is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) shows a short text post on a coloured background. It is used only on a Page feed post with no photo, video or link card and at most 130 characters; anywhere else it is left out and the post publishes as plain text. Facebook retires backgrounds over time, so if Facebook refuses the background the post is published once more without it rather than failing. Instagram: { collaborators, shareToStory, userTags, shareToFeed, locationId, trialReel (post type `reel` only — ignored on `feed_video`), graduationStrategy ('manual'|'auto' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; ignored unless trialReel is true), thumbnailTimestamp (seconds), coverUrl }. collaborators is a comma-separated list of Instagram usernames (no leading @) tagged as co-authors; it applies to post types feed_photo, feed_video, reel and carousel — on a carousel it is set on the carousel itself rather than on its individual items — and is ignored on story, which has no co-author concept. thumbnailTimestamp and coverUrl both set the still shown before a video or Reel plays, and both apply to post types feed_video and reel; coverUrl wins when both are sent, because Instagram rejects a request carrying both. userTags is an array of { username, x, y, mediaIndex }: username is a public Instagram account (letters, numbers, periods, underscores, up to 30 characters, leading @ optional); x and y are the person's position on the photo as fractions from 0 to 1 from the top left, given together or not at all; mediaIndex is the item of the post's media the tag belongs to, counting from 0 in attachment order (default 0). Up to 20 people per photo or video. On a single photo and on each photo of a carousel a tag needs x and y, and a tag without a position is left out; on a Reel or video post people are tagged by username only, any position is ignored and mediaIndex does not matter; carousel videos and Stories carry no tags. Tags follow position, so re-check them if you reorder media. Invalid username, x or y outside 0 to 1 or only one of them, a negative or fractional mediaIndex, more than 20 on one item, or a non-array value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. shareToFeed (boolean) applies to Reels only: false shows the Reel only in the Reels tab, true also shows it in the main feed, and when omitted Instagram's own default applies (feed and Reels tab); it is ignored on every other post type, and a non-boolean value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. locationId (string of digits) tags a place by the numeric ID of a Facebook Page that has a location; it applies to photos, videos, Reels and carousels but not Stories, anything but digits is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, and if Instagram does not recognise the ID as a place it refuses the post. TikTok: { privacyLevel ('PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE'|'MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS'|'FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR'|'SELF_ONLY' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; only the levels the connected account's creator info lists are accepted by TikTok), disableDuet, disableStitch, disableComment, isAigc, brandContentToggle, brandOrganicToggle, thumbnailTimestamp, sendToDrafts, photoCoverIndex, autoAddMusic }. sendToDrafts (boolean, default false) sends a video or photo_slideshow post to the creator's TikTok drafts instead of publishing it; TikTok notifies the creator, who adds a sound, chooses who can view it and posts it from the app. With sendToDrafts true, privacyLevel is not required, and privacyLevel, disableDuet, disableStitch, disableComment, isAigc, brandContentToggle, brandOrganicToggle, autoAddMusic and thumbnailTimestamp are ignored. A video draft carries no caption (the creator writes it in the app); a photo draft sends the caption and honours photoCoverIndex. Once TikTok has the draft, the post's TikTok destination becomes published with no platformUrl, because there is no public post until the creator posts it. For about a week after that we check whether the creator has posted it; once they have, platformPostId becomes the TikTok video id, platformUrl is filled in, and analytics are collected from then on. A draft posted later than that keeps no platformUrl. A non-boolean value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. photoCoverIndex (integer 0 to 34, default 0) picks which image of a photo_slideshow post is the cover, counting from 0 in attachment order; it is ignored on video posts, any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, and an index past the last attached image falls back to the first image. autoAddMusic (boolean, default false) applies to photo posts that are published directly and lets TikTok add a recommended track; it is ignored with sendToDrafts. YouTube: { title, privacyStatus ('public'|'unlisted'|'private' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), categoryId, madeForKids, playlistId, thumbnailUrl, containsSyntheticMedia, notifySubscribers, license, embeddable, publicStatsViewable, defaultLanguage, defaultAudioLanguage, recordingDate }. The last eight apply to post types video and short and are sent to YouTube only when set, so YouTube's own defaults (and the channel's upload defaults) apply otherwise. containsSyntheticMedia (boolean) true discloses realistic altered or synthetic content. notifySubscribers (boolean): only an explicit false changes anything and publishes without notifying subscribers. license ('youtube'|'creativeCommon'; default youtube; creativeCommon publishes under Creative Commons Attribution; any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR). embeddable (boolean): false stops other websites embedding the video. publicStatsViewable (boolean): false hides extended statistics on the watch page. defaultLanguage is the language of the title and description and defaultAudioLanguage the language spoken in the video, each a language code such as 'en', 'pt-BR' or 'zh-Hans'. recordingDate is YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 date-time; a plain date is stored as midnight UTC. A non-boolean, bad language code or bad date is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Pinterest: { title, description, link, coverKeyFrameTime, boardSectionId, [channelId]: { boardId, boardSectionId } }. boardSectionId (numeric string) puts the pin in a section of the chosen board, sent beside its board either per channel or as the flat pair; list a board's sections with GET /api/channels/{id}/options?boardId=<boardId> on a Pinterest channel. It applies to pin, video_pin and carousel; a non-numeric value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, a flat boardSectionId is ignored for a channel that has its own boardId, and any section is ignored when no board was chosen and the pin goes to the default board. coverKeyFrameTime (integer seconds, video_pin only, 0 or more) uses the frame at that time as the cover, and a time past the end uses the last frame; coverImageUrl wins when both are sent; any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. LinkedIn: { url, title, description, documentTitle, poll, reshareId, thumbnailUrl, visibility, disableReshare }. On an `article` post, url (an http(s) link) is required and title and description are optional text for the link card; a missing url is only reported when the post is published. Every field is optional on its own; what a post type needs is checked when the post is scheduled or published, so a draft may be incomplete. documentTitle (string) is the title shown above the document in the feed on a `document` post; it defaults to the file's name. poll is { question, options, duration } on a `poll` post: question is up to 140 characters, options is 2 to 4 strings of up to 30 characters each (surrounding spaces trimmed, blank entries ignored) and duration is 'ONE_DAY'|'THREE_DAYS'|'SEVEN_DAYS'|'FOURTEEN_DAYS' (default THREE_DAYS); a poll needs post text as well as the question and cannot carry media, and any violation is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. reshareId is the post to share on a `reshare` post, as its LinkedIn link (on LinkedIn, the post's menu, 'Copy link to post') or its urn:li:share:<id> or urn:li:ugcPost:<id> ID; activity links (urn:li:activity:<id>) cannot be reshared and are rejected when the post is scheduled or published, as is any value no post can be read from. A reshare takes optional post text, published alongside the shared post, and no media. thumbnailUrl is the cover for a `post` that carries a video: a public http(s) link to an image of up to 10MB, and a value that is not a public http(s) link is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; a cover that cannot be fetched, is not an image or is over 10MB is skipped and the video publishes with the frame LinkedIn picks. visibility ('PUBLIC'|'CONNECTIONS'|'LOGGED_IN'; default PUBLIC; any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) sets who can see the post: anyone, your first-degree connections, or signed-in LinkedIn members. CONNECTIONS applies to personal profiles only: on a Page it is published as PUBLIC, because a Page has no connections. disableReshare (boolean, default false) stops other members resharing the post, and a non-boolean value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. visibility and disableReshare apply to every LinkedIn post type. GMB: { ctaType ('BOOK'|'ORDER'|'SHOP'|'LEARN_MORE'|'SIGN_UP'|'CALL' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), ctaUrl, eventTitle, startDate, startTime, endDate, endTime, couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, termsConditions }. X: { replySettings ('everyone'|'following'|'verified'|'subscribers'|'mentionedUsers' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), poll, quoteId, communityId, shareWithFollowers }. replySettings applies to a single post and to the first post of a thread. poll is { options, durationMinutes }: options is 2 to 4 strings of 1 to 25 characters each (surrounding spaces trimmed) and durationMinutes is a whole number from 5 to 10080. quoteId is the post to quote, as its numeric ID or its URL (x.com or twitter.com status links). A poll cannot be combined with media or with quoteId, and either combination is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (a poll with media is checked when the post is scheduled or published, so a draft may hold both). communityId posts into an X Community, as its numeric ID or its URL (https://x.com/i/communities/<id>); the account must be a member. shareWithFollowers (boolean, default false) also shows a community post to followers and is ignored without communityId. On a thread, poll, quoteId and communityId apply to the first post only. None of these applies to a repost. Threads: { quotePostId, topicTag, locationId, replyControl, pollOptions, linkAttachment }. topicTag is one topic per post, sent without a leading '#'; a value containing a period or an ampersand is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. locationId is a numeric place ID from GET /api/channels/{id}/options?q=<place> on a Threads channel (any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR); location search is available only once the connected Threads account has granted location tagging, and the options endpoint answers { unavailable: true } until then. Both apply to the root post of a thread, never to its replies. replyControl ('everyone'|'accounts_you_follow'|'mentioned_only'|'parent_post_author_only'|'followers_only'; default everyone, which is not sent) sets who can reply; parent_post_author_only means only you. It applies to the post itself (text, image, video, carousel and the first part of a thread), never to later replies in a thread, and is ignored on a repost. Any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, with a 'did you mean' hint for upper-case spellings. pollOptions is an array of 2 to 4 strings of 1 to 25 characters each after trimming (empty strings are ignored, and an array with none filled means no poll); Threads allows polls on text-only posts, so on an image, video or carousel post the poll is left out and the post publishes without it, and in a thread the poll goes on the first part when it has no media. A non-array, 1 or more than 4 filled options, or an option over 25 characters is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. linkAttachment is an http(s) URL on a public host that Threads shows as the preview card on a text post; it is left out on any other post type, and when omitted Threads shows a card for the first link in the text. Threads refuses a post with more than 5 links in total, and a linkAttachment that differs from every link in the text counts as one more. A non-URL, non-http scheme or private host is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Bluesky: { replyAllow, allowQuotes, quoteId, langs, contentLabel }. replyAllow is an array of who can reply: omitted or [] means everyone, otherwise ['nobody'] or any combination of 'mention' (accounts mentioned in the post), 'following' (accounts you follow) and 'follower' (your followers); 'nobody' cannot be combined with other values and any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. replyAllow and allowQuotes are set right after the post publishes; if Bluesky refuses the setting the post stays published without it. allowQuotes (boolean, default true) false stops other accounts quoting the post. quoteId is the post to quote, as a https://bsky.app/profile/<handle>/post/<id> link or an at:// post URI (a bare ID is read as one of your own posts); with images or a video attached the quote and media appear together, a quote replaces a link card, and if the post cannot be found publishing fails before anything is posted. langs is up to 3 language codes such as 'en' or 'pt-BR'; more than 3 or a value that is not a language code is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. contentLabel ('sexual'|'nudity'|'porn'|'graphic-media') adds a content warning, and any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. replyAllow, allowQuotes and quoteId apply to the first post of a thread; langs and contentLabel apply to every part; none applies to a repost. Mastodon: { poll, sensitive, quoteId }. poll is { options, expiresIn, multiple, hideTotals }: options is 2 to 4 strings of 1 to 50 characters, expiresIn is a whole number of seconds from 300 to 2629746, multiple (boolean, default false) lets voters pick more than one choice, and hideTotals (boolean, default false) hides counts until the poll ends. A poll cannot be combined with media (rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when the post is scheduled or published, so a draft may hold both), and a server configured with tighter limits refuses the post at publish time with its own message. sensitive (boolean, default false) hides attached media behind a click and has no effect without media; it applies to every part of a thread. quoteId is the post to quote, as its URL or its status ID on your own server (a URL from another server is looked up from your account first); quote posts need a server running Mastodon 4.5 or later, and on an older server publishing fails with 'Your Mastodon server does not support quote posts yet' and nothing is posted. If the quoted author does not allow quotes, Mastodon refuses the post. poll and quoteId apply to the first post of a thread; none applies to a repost. Discord: { [channelId]: { channelId, silent, buttons, startThread, threadName, embed, poll, pin, tags } } — the outer key is the BulkPublish channel id, the inner channelId is the target Discord text channel. silent (boolean) suppresses notifications. buttons is an array of { label, url } link buttons: up to 5, label up to 80 characters, url http(s); a row left completely blank is dropped. startThread (boolean) starts a thread from the message, named by threadName (up to 100 characters); it has no effect on a forum channel, where each post is already its own thread. embed is { title (up to 256 characters), color ('orange'|'blue'|'green'|'red'|'purple'|'gray') } and sends the text as a rich embed with the first image inside. poll is { question (up to 300 characters), answers (2 to 10 strings of up to 55 characters), durationHours (whole number from 1 to 768, default 24), multiselect (boolean, default false) }; a forum channel's starter message cannot carry a poll, so a poll is left off a forum post. pin (boolean) pins the message; if Discord refuses, the post stays published and a warning is recorded. tags is up to 5 forum tag IDs (digits) for a forum channel; the forum channels and their tag IDs come from GET /api/channels/{id}/options. Pinning and polls need the bot to hold the Pin Messages and Send Polls permissions: servers where the bot was added earlier must grant them in the server's role settings, otherwise those options are refused by Discord. Any value outside these limits is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the path, for example platformSpecific.discord.123.poll.answers accepts at most 10 answers. Telegram: { [channelId]: { silent, protectContent, pin, threadId, buttons, spoiler, disablePreview, poll } }; the destination chat is fixed when the channel is connected. silent (boolean) sends without a notification sound; protectContent (boolean) stops recipients forwarding or saving the message; pin (boolean) pins it after sending, and if the bot lacks the right to pin the post still publishes and a warning is recorded; threadId (digits, up to 12) is the forum topic to post into; buttons is an array of { label, url } link buttons: up to 3, label up to 64 characters, url http(s), blank rows dropped; spoiler (boolean) hides a photo or video behind a spoiler; disablePreview (boolean) turns off the link preview. poll is { question (1 to 300 characters, required), options (2 to 12 strings of up to 100 characters), anonymous (boolean, default true), multipleAnswers (boolean, default false), quiz (boolean, default false), correctOption } and is sent as a poll after the message; correctOption is the 0-based index of the right answer and is required when quiz is true, and multipleAnswers cannot be combined with quiz. A non-boolean flag, an out-of-range value or a malformed button or poll is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the path, for example platformSpecific.telegram.123.poll.options needs at least 2 answers. Attached GIFs, audio and other files are sent to Telegram as an animation, an audio file or a document according to their type. Tumblr: { [channelId]: { blogName, title, tags (array of strings, or one comma-separated string; leading '#' and blank entries are dropped), link, sourceUrl, state, slug, reblogInteraction, reblogUrl } }; blogName defaults to the blog the channel was connected as. state ('published'|'queue'|'draft'|'private'; default published; any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) sets where the post goes: a scheduled post with state published still goes out at its scheduled time, while draft and private override that and the post is never made public by BulkPublish. slug (up to 200 characters) is lowercased and hyphenated into the permalink. reblogInteraction ('everyone'|'noone') sets who can reblog the post. reblogUrl is a Tumblr post link (tumblr.com/<blog>/<post id> or <blog>.tumblr.com/post/<post id>) and publishes a reblog of that post with your text as the comment; a value that is not a Tumblr post link is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Snapchat: { [channelId]: { title (Saved Story title, max 45 chars — defaults to the caption's first line), locale (Spotlight locale, default 'en_US'), link (Story and Spotlight: a full http(s) URL, max 2000 chars, opened from a link sticker on the snap), linkStickerText (up to 40 chars, one line, no emoji; ignored without a link), linkStickerPosition ('top'|'middle'|'bottom'; ignored without a link; Snapchat centres it when omitted), overlayText (Story and Spotlight on-screen text, up to 250 chars, no emoji), overlayPosition ('top'|'middle'|'bottom'), storyDurationDays (Story only: 1, 2, 3 or 7; default 1, i.e. 24 hours). A video carrying link or overlayText must be vertical (9:16); photos of any shape are fine. Invalid values are rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR whatever the post type; a saved_story ignores all six, and sticker text and position are ignored without a link. saveToProfile (Spotlight only) is still accepted but has no effect: Snapchat no longer lets an app choose whether a Spotlight is saved to the profile } }; post types are story (default; caption not sent to Snapchat), saved_story and spotlight (video only, caption becomes the 160-char description); every Snapchat post requires exactly one image or video. Links held in these options are tracked like links in the caption when link tracking is on for the post: snapchat link (not on a saved_story) is sent as a bulkpubli.sh short link, so its clicks are counted (if Snapchat refuses the short link, the post is published with the link as written); tumblr link, pinterest link and gmb ctaUrl / redeemOnlineUrl are never shortened and still point straight at your site (Tumblr builds its link card from the address it is given, and Pinterest may block links that redirect). Wherever the workspace adds UTM tags to caption links automatically, these links get the same tags. The stored values always stay as written. Telegram, Discord, Tumblr and Snapchat also accept a flat (non channel-id-keyed) object that applies to every channel of that platform on the post; both shapes are validated. Use _firstComment (string), at the TOP level of platformSpecific rather than inside a platform key, for an auto-posted reply after publish. Supported on x, instagram, facebook, linkedin, youtube, threads, bluesky, mastodon and telegram; NOT supported on discord, pinterest, tiktok, gmb or tumblr, where the main post still publishes and the comment is recorded as failed. Snapchat does not support first comments either.

discord.description: Keyed by BulkPublish channel id (e.g. "12"), or flat to apply to every Discord channel on the post. The fields below are those of the inner object.

channelId.description: Required. The target Discord text channel id (a snowflake) within the connected server. Note this is a Discord channel id, not the BulkPublish channel id used as the outer key. List postable channels via GET /api/channels/{id}/options.

thumbnailUrl.description: Cover image for a video or Reel, as a public image URL. Facebook only accepts a cover once the video exists, so it is applied after the video publishes and appears a moment after the post. A cover that cannot be fetched, or that Facebook rejects, leaves the video published with the frame Facebook chose and does not fail the post. Omit to let Facebook choose.

ctaUrl.description: Where the button sends people (not used with ctaType CALL). Never shortened; when the workspace adds UTM tags to caption links automatically, this link gets them too. The stored value stays as written.

redeemOnlineUrl.description: Offer posts: where the offer is redeemed online. Never shortened; when the workspace adds UTM tags to caption links automatically, this link gets them too. The stored value stays as written.

collaborators.description: Comma-separated Instagram usernames without @, tagged as co-authors. Applies to post types `feed_photo`, `feed_video`, `reel` and `carousel` — on a carousel the co-authors are set on the carousel itself, not on its individual items. Ignored on `story`, which has no co-author concept.

coverUrl.description: Cover image for a video or Reel, as a public image URL. Takes precedence over thumbnailTimestamp: Instagram accepts one or the other and rejects a request carrying both, so when both are sent only this one is forwarded.

graduationStrategy.description: How a trial reel becomes a normal one: `manual` (you release it yourself) or `auto` (released for you if it performs well). Any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Ignored unless `trialReel` is true. Default `manual`.

thumbnailTimestamp.description: Cover frame for a video or Reel, in seconds from the start. Applies to post types feed_video and reel. Ignored when coverUrl is also set.

trialReel.description: Publish as a trial reel — shown to non-followers first. Applies ONLY when the post type is `reel`: a `feed_video` posts as an ordinary reel and this field is ignored, even though both post types use the same underlying reel container. Default false.

coverImageUrl.description: Cover image URL for video pins. Optional — when omitted, an image attached alongside the video is used, otherwise the auto-extracted poster frame of the video. Publishing fails only if none of the three is available.

link.description: Destination URL. Never shortened, because Pinterest may block links that redirect; when the workspace adds UTM tags to caption links automatically, this link gets them too. The stored value stays as written.

snapchat.description: Keyed by BulkPublish channel id (e.g. "12"), or flat to apply to every Snapchat channel on the post. Post types: story (default), saved_story, spotlight. Every Snapchat post requires exactly one image or video; spotlight is video-only (6–60s); story videos must be 5–60s, and saved_story videos have no documented length and are not checked. A video outside its range is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when the post is scheduled or published (drafts may be saved with it). The caption is used only for Spotlight (160-char description) and as the Saved Story title fallback — plain stories carry no caption, though a Story or Spotlight can carry a link sticker and on-screen text (link, overlayText). A video with either must be vertical (9:16).

link.description: Story and Spotlight. A full http:// or https:// URL, opened from a link sticker on the snap. Ignored on a saved_story. With link tracking on for the post, it is sent as a short link, the same as links in the caption (including their automatic UTM tags, when the workspace adds them), so its clicks are counted; if Snapchat refuses the short link, the post is published with the link as written. The stored value stays as written.

linkStickerPosition.description: Where the link sticker sits. Ignored without a link. Snapchat centres it when omitted.

linkStickerText.description: Text on the link sticker: one line, up to 40 characters, no emoji. Ignored without a link.

locale.description: Spotlight locale, e.g. 'en_US'. Defaults to 'en_US' when omitted.

overlayPosition.description: Where the on-screen text sits. Snapchat's default when omitted.

overlayText.description: Story and Spotlight. On-screen text shown on the snap, up to 250 characters, no emoji. Separate from the caption. Ignored on a saved_story.

saveToProfile.description: Spotlight only. Accepted but has no effect: Snapchat no longer lets an app choose whether a Spotlight is saved to the profile, so nothing is sent for it.

storyDurationDays.description: Story only. How many days the story stays up: 1 (24 hours, Snapchat's default), 2, 3 or 7. Ignored on saved_story and spotlight.

title.description: Saved Story title (max 45 chars). Defaults to the first line of the caption, truncated.

telegram.description: Telegram accepts no platform-specific options — the destination chat is fixed when the channel is connected. Content is sent as plain text (no parse mode). Text longer than the 1024-character caption limit is posted as a second message alongside captionless media.

thumbnailTimestamp.description: Cover frame for the video, in seconds from the start. Must be a number, not a numeric string: a string is ignored and TikTok picks its own frame.

tumblr.description: Keyed by BulkPublish channel id (e.g. "12"), or flat to apply to every Tumblr channel on the post. The fields below are those of the inner object.

blogName.description: Which blog to publish to. Defaults to the blog the channel was connected as (the account's primary blog). List the account's blogs via GET /api/channels/{id}/options.

link.description: Appended to the post as a link block. Never shortened, because Tumblr builds the card from this address; when the workspace adds UTM tags to caption links automatically, this link gets them too. The stored value stays as written.

sourceUrl.description: Attribution URL stored as the post's source.

tags.description: Tumblr tags, without the leading '#'.

title.description: Rendered as a heading block above the post body.

replySettings.description: Who can reply to this tweet

approvalStatus.description: Team approval state, orthogonal to status. 'pending' and 'rejected' posts do not publish, even when scheduled and overdue; approving via POST /api/posts/{id}/approve releases them (an overdue post publishes immediately on approval if its time passed less than 15 minutes ago; later than that it publishes immediately only when publishWhenApproved is true or the approver sends whenLate 'publish', and is otherwise approved but returned to draft for the author to reschedule). Members whose role lacks post:publish (contributors) always get 'pending' when scheduling; others can opt in with requestApproval.

approvedBy.description: User ID of the approver (set when approvalStatus is 'approved').

approver.description: The member who approved the post. Null unless approvalStatus is 'approved' and that account still exists.

assignedAt.description: When the post was assigned. Null once it is unassigned.

assignedUserId.description: User ID of the assignee; `assignee` carries the same person with a display name.

assignee.description: The member expected to act on the post next, or null when nobody is. Set with assignedUserId on PATCH /api/posts/{id}.

author.description: The member who wrote the post. Null when that account no longer exists.

deleteMediaAfterPublish.description: Whether uploaded media is deleted right after publishing. When true, the file's original is removed once every channel on the post has published, and the space it used stops counting toward your media storage limit; the library entry itself stays, showing a preview and the original's size, and is marked as having its original deleted. Defaults to false — media is kept and reclaimed by the 3-month retention sweep. Always false for recurring-schedule posts and bulk-created posts.

hasShareLink.description: Whether a read-only review link exists for the post. The token itself is never returned on reads; POST /api/posts/{id}/share returns the URL to the roles allowed to manage links.

platformContent.description: Per-platform content overrides mapping platform name to a plain string, e.g. { "x": "Short version" }. Values must be strings — nested objects are rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

platformSpecific.description: Per-platform options. Keys are platform names. Facebook: { shareToStory, thumbnailUrl, textFormatPresetId }. thumbnailUrl is the cover for a video or Reel; it is applied to the video after it publishes, so it lands a moment after the post, and a cover that cannot be fetched or is rejected leaves the video published with Facebook's own chosen frame rather than failing the post. textFormatPresetId (string of digits, a Facebook background ID; anything else is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) shows a short text post on a coloured background. It is used only on a Page feed post with no photo, video or link card and at most 130 characters; anywhere else it is left out and the post publishes as plain text. Facebook retires backgrounds over time, so if Facebook refuses the background the post is published once more without it rather than failing. Instagram: { collaborators, shareToStory, userTags, shareToFeed, locationId, trialReel (post type `reel` only — ignored on `feed_video`), graduationStrategy ('manual'|'auto' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; ignored unless trialReel is true), thumbnailTimestamp (seconds), coverUrl }. collaborators is a comma-separated list of Instagram usernames (no leading @) tagged as co-authors; it applies to post types feed_photo, feed_video, reel and carousel — on a carousel it is set on the carousel itself rather than on its individual items — and is ignored on story, which has no co-author concept. thumbnailTimestamp and coverUrl both set the still shown before a video or Reel plays, and both apply to post types feed_video and reel; coverUrl wins when both are sent, because Instagram rejects a request carrying both. userTags is an array of { username, x, y, mediaIndex }: username is a public Instagram account (letters, numbers, periods, underscores, up to 30 characters, leading @ optional); x and y are the person's position on the photo as fractions from 0 to 1 from the top left, given together or not at all; mediaIndex is the item of the post's media the tag belongs to, counting from 0 in attachment order (default 0). Up to 20 people per photo or video. On a single photo and on each photo of a carousel a tag needs x and y, and a tag without a position is left out; on a Reel or video post people are tagged by username only, any position is ignored and mediaIndex does not matter; carousel videos and Stories carry no tags. Tags follow position, so re-check them if you reorder media. Invalid username, x or y outside 0 to 1 or only one of them, a negative or fractional mediaIndex, more than 20 on one item, or a non-array value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. shareToFeed (boolean) applies to Reels only: false shows the Reel only in the Reels tab, true also shows it in the main feed, and when omitted Instagram's own default applies (feed and Reels tab); it is ignored on every other post type, and a non-boolean value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. locationId (string of digits) tags a place by the numeric ID of a Facebook Page that has a location; it applies to photos, videos, Reels and carousels but not Stories, anything but digits is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, and if Instagram does not recognise the ID as a place it refuses the post. TikTok: { privacyLevel ('PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE'|'MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS'|'FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR'|'SELF_ONLY' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; only the levels the connected account's creator info lists are accepted by TikTok), disableDuet, disableStitch, disableComment, isAigc, brandContentToggle, brandOrganicToggle, thumbnailTimestamp, sendToDrafts, photoCoverIndex, autoAddMusic }. sendToDrafts (boolean, default false) sends a video or photo_slideshow post to the creator's TikTok drafts instead of publishing it; TikTok notifies the creator, who adds a sound, chooses who can view it and posts it from the app. With sendToDrafts true, privacyLevel is not required, and privacyLevel, disableDuet, disableStitch, disableComment, isAigc, brandContentToggle, brandOrganicToggle, autoAddMusic and thumbnailTimestamp are ignored. A video draft carries no caption (the creator writes it in the app); a photo draft sends the caption and honours photoCoverIndex. Once TikTok has the draft, the post's TikTok destination becomes published with no platformUrl, because there is no public post until the creator posts it. For about a week after that we check whether the creator has posted it; once they have, platformPostId becomes the TikTok video id, platformUrl is filled in, and analytics are collected from then on. A draft posted later than that keeps no platformUrl. A non-boolean value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. photoCoverIndex (integer 0 to 34, default 0) picks which image of a photo_slideshow post is the cover, counting from 0 in attachment order; it is ignored on video posts, any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, and an index past the last attached image falls back to the first image. autoAddMusic (boolean, default false) applies to photo posts that are published directly and lets TikTok add a recommended track; it is ignored with sendToDrafts. YouTube: { title, privacyStatus ('public'|'unlisted'|'private' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), categoryId, madeForKids, playlistId, thumbnailUrl, containsSyntheticMedia, notifySubscribers, license, embeddable, publicStatsViewable, defaultLanguage, defaultAudioLanguage, recordingDate }. The last eight apply to post types video and short and are sent to YouTube only when set, so YouTube's own defaults (and the channel's upload defaults) apply otherwise. containsSyntheticMedia (boolean) true discloses realistic altered or synthetic content. notifySubscribers (boolean): only an explicit false changes anything and publishes without notifying subscribers. license ('youtube'|'creativeCommon'; default youtube; creativeCommon publishes under Creative Commons Attribution; any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR). embeddable (boolean): false stops other websites embedding the video. publicStatsViewable (boolean): false hides extended statistics on the watch page. defaultLanguage is the language of the title and description and defaultAudioLanguage the language spoken in the video, each a language code such as 'en', 'pt-BR' or 'zh-Hans'. recordingDate is YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 date-time; a plain date is stored as midnight UTC. A non-boolean, bad language code or bad date is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Every field is optional on its own; what a post type needs is checked when the post is scheduled or published, so a draft may be incomplete. documentTitle (string) is the title shown above the document in the feed on a `document` post; it defaults to the file's name. poll is { question, options, duration } on a `poll` post: question is up to 140 characters, options is 2 to 4 strings of up to 30 characters each (surrounding spaces trimmed, blank entries ignored) and duration is 'ONE_DAY'|'THREE_DAYS'|'SEVEN_DAYS'|'FOURTEEN_DAYS' (default THREE_DAYS); a poll needs post text as well as the question and cannot carry media, and any violation is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. reshareId is the post to share on a `reshare` post, as its LinkedIn link (on LinkedIn, the post's menu, 'Copy link to post') or its urn:li:share:<id> or urn:li:ugcPost:<id> ID; activity links (urn:li:activity:<id>) cannot be reshared and are rejected when the post is scheduled or published, as is any value no post can be read from. A reshare takes optional post text, published alongside the shared post, and no media. thumbnailUrl is the cover for a `post` that carries a video: a public http(s) link to an image of up to 10MB, and a value that is not a public http(s) link is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR; a cover that cannot be fetched, is not an image or is over 10MB is skipped and the video publishes with the frame LinkedIn picks. visibility ('PUBLIC'|'CONNECTIONS'|'LOGGED_IN'; default PUBLIC; any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) sets who can see the post: anyone, your first-degree connections, or signed-in LinkedIn members. CONNECTIONS applies to personal profiles only: on a Page it is published as PUBLIC, because a Page has no connections. disableReshare (boolean, default false) stops other members resharing the post, and a non-boolean value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. visibility and disableReshare apply to every LinkedIn post type. GMB: { ctaType ('BOOK'|'ORDER'|'SHOP'|'LEARN_MORE'|'SIGN_UP'|'CALL' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), ctaUrl, eventTitle, startDate, startTime, endDate, endTime, couponCode, redeemOnlineUrl, termsConditions }. X: { replySettings ('everyone'|'following'|'verified'|'subscribers'|'mentionedUsers' — any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR), poll, quoteId, communityId, shareWithFollowers }. replySettings applies to a single post and to the first post of a thread. poll is { options, durationMinutes }: options is 2 to 4 strings of 1 to 25 characters each (surrounding spaces trimmed) and durationMinutes is a whole number from 5 to 10080. quoteId is the post to quote, as its numeric ID or its URL (x.com or twitter.com status links). A poll cannot be combined with media or with quoteId, and either combination is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (a poll with media is checked when the post is scheduled or published, so a draft may hold both). communityId posts into an X Community, as its numeric ID or its URL (https://x.com/i/communities/<id>); the account must be a member. shareWithFollowers (boolean, default false) also shows a community post to followers and is ignored without communityId. On a thread, poll, quoteId and communityId apply to the first post only. None of these applies to a repost. Threads: { quotePostId, topicTag, locationId, replyControl, pollOptions, linkAttachment }. topicTag is one topic per post, sent without a leading '#'; a value containing a period or an ampersand is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. locationId is a numeric place ID from GET /api/channels/{id}/options?q=<place> on a Threads channel (any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR); location search is available only once the connected Threads account has granted location tagging, and the options endpoint answers { unavailable: true } until then. Both apply to the root post of a thread, never to its replies. replyControl ('everyone'|'accounts_you_follow'|'mentioned_only'|'parent_post_author_only'|'followers_only'; default everyone, which is not sent) sets who can reply; parent_post_author_only means only you. It applies to the post itself (text, image, video, carousel and the first part of a thread), never to later replies in a thread, and is ignored on a repost. Any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR, with a 'did you mean' hint for upper-case spellings. pollOptions is an array of 2 to 4 strings of 1 to 25 characters each after trimming (empty strings are ignored, and an array with none filled means no poll); Threads allows polls on text-only posts, so on an image, video or carousel post the poll is left out and the post publishes without it, and in a thread the poll goes on the first part when it has no media. A non-array, 1 or more than 4 filled options, or an option over 25 characters is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. linkAttachment is an http(s) URL on a public host that Threads shows as the preview card on a text post; it is left out on any other post type, and when omitted Threads shows a card for the first link in the text. Threads refuses a post with more than 5 links in total, and a linkAttachment that differs from every link in the text counts as one more. A non-URL, non-http scheme or private host is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Bluesky: { replyAllow, allowQuotes, quoteId, langs, contentLabel }. replyAllow is an array of who can reply: omitted or [] means everyone, otherwise ['nobody'] or any combination of 'mention' (accounts mentioned in the post), 'following' (accounts you follow) and 'follower' (your followers); 'nobody' cannot be combined with other values and any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. replyAllow and allowQuotes are set right after the post publishes; if Bluesky refuses the setting the post stays published without it. allowQuotes (boolean, default true) false stops other accounts quoting the post. quoteId is the post to quote, as a https://bsky.app/profile/<handle>/post/<id> link or an at:// post URI (a bare ID is read as one of your own posts); with images or a video attached the quote and media appear together, a quote replaces a link card, and if the post cannot be found publishing fails before anything is posted. langs is up to 3 language codes such as 'en' or 'pt-BR'; more than 3 or a value that is not a language code is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. contentLabel ('sexual'|'nudity'|'porn'|'graphic-media') adds a content warning, and any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. replyAllow, allowQuotes and quoteId apply to the first post of a thread; langs and contentLabel apply to every part; none applies to a repost. Mastodon: { poll, sensitive, quoteId }. poll is { options, expiresIn, multiple, hideTotals }: options is 2 to 4 strings of 1 to 50 characters, expiresIn is a whole number of seconds from 300 to 2629746, multiple (boolean, default false) lets voters pick more than one choice, and hideTotals (boolean, default false) hides counts until the poll ends. A poll cannot be combined with media (rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when the post is scheduled or published, so a draft may hold both), and a server configured with tighter limits refuses the post at publish time with its own message. sensitive (boolean, default false) hides attached media behind a click and has no effect without media; it applies to every part of a thread. quoteId is the post to quote, as its URL or its status ID on your own server (a URL from another server is looked up from your account first); quote posts need a server running Mastodon 4.5 or later, and on an older server publishing fails with 'Your Mastodon server does not support quote posts yet' and nothing is posted. If the quoted author does not allow quotes, Mastodon refuses the post. poll and quoteId apply to the first post of a thread; none applies to a repost. Discord: { [channelId]: { channelId, silent, buttons, startThread, threadName, embed, poll, pin, tags } } — the outer key is the BulkPublish channel id, the inner channelId is the target Discord text channel. silent (boolean) suppresses notifications. buttons is an array of { label, url } link buttons: up to 5, label up to 80 characters, url http(s); a row left completely blank is dropped. startThread (boolean) starts a thread from the message, named by threadName (up to 100 characters); it has no effect on a forum channel, where each post is already its own thread. embed is { title (up to 256 characters), color ('orange'|'blue'|'green'|'red'|'purple'|'gray') } and sends the text as a rich embed with the first image inside. poll is { question (up to 300 characters), answers (2 to 10 strings of up to 55 characters), durationHours (whole number from 1 to 768, default 24), multiselect (boolean, default false) }; a forum channel's starter message cannot carry a poll, so a poll is left off a forum post. pin (boolean) pins the message; if Discord refuses, the post stays published and a warning is recorded. tags is up to 5 forum tag IDs (digits) for a forum channel; the forum channels and their tag IDs come from GET /api/channels/{id}/options. Pinning and polls need the bot to hold the Pin Messages and Send Polls permissions: servers where the bot was added earlier must grant them in the server's role settings, otherwise those options are refused by Discord. Any value outside these limits is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the path, for example platformSpecific.discord.123.poll.answers accepts at most 10 answers. Telegram: { [channelId]: { silent, protectContent, pin, threadId, buttons, spoiler, disablePreview, poll } }; the destination chat is fixed when the channel is connected. silent (boolean) sends without a notification sound; protectContent (boolean) stops recipients forwarding or saving the message; pin (boolean) pins it after sending, and if the bot lacks the right to pin the post still publishes and a warning is recorded; threadId (digits, up to 12) is the forum topic to post into; buttons is an array of { label, url } link buttons: up to 3, label up to 64 characters, url http(s), blank rows dropped; spoiler (boolean) hides a photo or video behind a spoiler; disablePreview (boolean) turns off the link preview. poll is { question (1 to 300 characters, required), options (2 to 12 strings of up to 100 characters), anonymous (boolean, default true), multipleAnswers (boolean, default false), quiz (boolean, default false), correctOption } and is sent as a poll after the message; correctOption is the 0-based index of the right answer and is required when quiz is true, and multipleAnswers cannot be combined with quiz. A non-boolean flag, an out-of-range value or a malformed button or poll is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the path, for example platformSpecific.telegram.123.poll.options needs at least 2 answers. Attached GIFs, audio and other files are sent to Telegram as an animation, an audio file or a document according to their type. Tumblr: { [channelId]: { blogName, title, tags (array of strings, or one comma-separated string; leading '#' and blank entries are dropped), link, sourceUrl, state, slug, reblogInteraction, reblogUrl } }; blogName defaults to the blog the channel was connected as. state ('published'|'queue'|'draft'|'private'; default published; any other value is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR) sets where the post goes: a scheduled post with state published still goes out at its scheduled time, while draft and private override that and the post is never made public by BulkPublish. slug (up to 200 characters) is lowercased and hyphenated into the permalink. reblogInteraction ('everyone'|'noone') sets who can reblog the post. reblogUrl is a Tumblr post link (tumblr.com/<blog>/<post id> or <blog>.tumblr.com/post/<post id>) and publishes a reblog of that post with your text as the comment; a value that is not a Tumblr post link is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. Telegram, Discord and Tumblr accept a flat (non channel-id-keyed) object that applies to every channel of that platform on the post; both shapes are validated. Snapchat: { [channelId]: { title (Saved Story title, max 45 chars — defaults to the caption's first line), locale (Spotlight locale, default 'en_US'), link (Story and Spotlight: a full http(s) URL, max 2000 chars, opened from a link sticker on the snap), linkStickerText (up to 40 chars, one line, no emoji; ignored without a link), linkStickerPosition ('top'|'middle'|'bottom'; ignored without a link; Snapchat centres it when omitted), overlayText (Story and Spotlight on-screen text, up to 250 chars, no emoji), overlayPosition ('top'|'middle'|'bottom'), storyDurationDays (Story only: 1, 2, 3 or 7; default 1, i.e. 24 hours). A video carrying link or overlayText must be vertical (9:16); photos of any shape are fine. Invalid values are rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR whatever the post type; a saved_story ignores all six, and sticker text and position are ignored without a link. saveToProfile (Spotlight only) is still accepted but has no effect: Snapchat no longer lets an app choose whether a Spotlight is saved to the profile } }. Links held in these options are tracked like links in the caption when link tracking is on for the post: snapchat link (not on a saved_story) is sent as a bulkpubli.sh short link, so its clicks are counted (if Snapchat refuses the short link, the post is published with the link as written); tumblr link, pinterest link and gmb ctaUrl / redeemOnlineUrl are never shortened and still point straight at your site (Tumblr builds its link card from the address it is given, and Pinterest may block links that redirect). Wherever the workspace adds UTM tags to caption links automatically, these links get the same tags. The stored values always stay as written. Use _firstComment (string) for auto-posted reply after publish.

postTypeOverrides.description: Per-platform post type override. E.g. { "instagram": "reel", "facebook": "story" }. A type the platform does not offer is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (previously it silently fell back to the platform default). Instagram: feed_photo, feed_video, reel, story, carousel. Facebook: post, reel, story. TikTok: video, photo_slideshow. YouTube: video, short. LinkedIn: post, multi_image, pdf_carousel, article, document, poll, reshare. Pinterest: pin, video_pin, carousel. GMB: standard, event, offer. Snapchat: story, saved_story, spotlight. Video length is checked against each platform's documented range for the chosen type, and a video outside it is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when the post is scheduled or published: Instagram reel and feed_video 3–900s, story 3–60s; Facebook reel 3–90s, story 3–60s; Threads video and carousel up to 300s; LinkedIn 3–1800s; Pinterest video_pin at least 4s; Snapchat story 5–60s, spotlight 6–60s. Other types and platforms are not length-checked. LinkedIn post types: `post` (text, one image or one video), `multi_image` (2 to 20 images), `pdf_carousel` (2 to 20 images shown as a swipeable carousel), `article` (a link with preview), `document` (one PDF, Word or PowerPoint file of up to 100MB and 300 pages, shown in the feed as a document people page through; needs exactly one document in `mediaIds` and no images or videos; title from `platformSpecific.linkedin.documentTitle`), `poll` (a question with 2 to 4 answers from `platformSpecific.linkedin.poll`; needs post text; takes no media) and `reshare` (shares an existing LinkedIn post from `platformSpecific.linkedin.reshareId`; post text is optional and is published alongside it; takes no media). A document can only be published to LinkedIn, as a `document` post: a post that carries a document and targets any other platform, or a LinkedIn post type other than `document`, is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when it is scheduled or published (a draft may hold one). `repost` (X, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon) reposts an existing post at the scheduled time: the post's own text and media are ignored and `platformSpecific.<platform>.repostId` must hold the target (X: status URL or ID; Mastodon: status URL or ID; Bluesky: bsky.app post URL or at:// URI; Threads: the numeric post ID; Threads links cannot be used, and for posts published through BulkPublish the ID is in the post details). A missing or unparsable target is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. This post type is available through the API only; the composer in the app does not offer it.

publishWhenApproved.description: True when the author asked for the post to go out as soon as it is approved, even if that is after its scheduled time. Only ever true while approvalStatus is 'pending': approving or rejecting the post sets it to false, and so does any change that takes the post out of 'pending'. When a post enters review again it starts from false unless the request sets it. Decides what POST /api/posts/{id}/approve does when it arrives more than 15 minutes late and no whenLate is sent.

recurringSchedule.description: Full recurring schedule details when linked

rejectedBy.description: User ID of the reviewer who rejected the post, alongside rejectionReason.

threadMediaFiles.description: Media referenced by threadParts[].mediaFileIds, resolved to full objects and de-duplicated across parts. Distinct from mediaFiles, which is the media on the post itself: a thread post can carry both, and a client that reads only mediaFiles will render a thread without its images.

threadParts.description: The ordered parts of a thread post. Null unless postFormat is 'thread'. Accepted on create and update; returned here since 2026-09.

updatedAt.description: When the post was last changed.

userId.description: User ID of the member who wrote the post. Returned on every post and always has been; `author` carries the same person with a display name.

status.description: Per-platform publish state. 'unconfirmed' is terminal: the publish request may have reached the platform but its response was lost, or the platform was still processing the upload when we stopped polling (video processing can outlast the check window) — check the account, then retry with republish: true if the post is not live.

kind.description: What the saved text is for: a post caption, or a first-comment reply.

requireApproval.description: Optional. Hold every occurrence this schedule generates for team approval — each generated post lands with approvalStatus 'pending' and does not publish until an approver releases it via POST /api/posts/{id}/approve. Default false. Forced to true server-side for roles without post:publish (contributors), regardless of this flag — on create and on every update, including an update that does not send the field.

apiKey.description: API key from Settings > API Keys. Pass as `Bearer bp_your_key_here`
apiKey.name: Authorization

oauth2.description:
**Beta.** For products that embed BulkPublish and do not want their users pasting an API key. The user approves your app on BulkPublish and you receive a scoped token bound to the workspace they chose. PKCE (S256) is required for every client, `scope` is required (there is no implicit default), authorization codes are single-use, and refresh tokens rotate. Pass the token as `Bearer bpat_...`.

OAuth tokens reach posts, schedules, labels, media, the Inbox, analytics, quota usage and read-only channel data — and nothing else. Grants made before the Inbox scopes existed do not cover it unless they hold `full`; `posts:write` never does. Account administration (team, organizations, billing and credit purchases, API keys, OAuth app management) returns 403 for **any** OAuth token, including `full`, because those actions would outlive the user disconnecting the app. Use an API key (`Bearer bp_...`) for those; keys are unaffected by this and remain the default for server-to-server use.

scopes.channels:read: See which social accounts are connected
scopes.full: Everything an app may do: read and write posts, schedules, labels, media and the Inbox, and read analytics and channels
scopes.inbox:read: Read the messages, reviews and comments in the Inbox
scopes.inbox:write: Reply to messages, reviews and comments, and organize the Inbox (read, archive, snooze, assign)
scopes.posts:write: Create, update, schedule and publish posts

info.description:
Publish to 15 social media platforms from a single API.

## Using this API from an AI agent

BulkPublish is also an [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server, so Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other agents can drive it directly. The two servers below expose different amounts of what is documented here.

**Hosted (web-based hosts):** add `https://mcp.bulkpublish.com/mcp` as a custom connector. It supports OAuth 2.1 — you paste your API key once on the consent screen — or a key in the URL (`?key=bp_...`) for hosts without OAuth. It exposes a focused set of tools — channels, posts, media, analytics, and the interactive panels — not one per endpoint below.

**Local (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf):** `npx -y @bulkpublish/mcp-server`, with `BULKPUBLISH_API_KEY` in the environment. This one exposes the full tool set, including schedules, RSS feeds, labels and quotas.

Per-client config and the full tool list: [BulkPublish AI Toolkit](https://github.com/azeemkafridi/bulkpublish-ai-toolkit). Get an API key at [/developer](https://app.bulkpublish.com/developer).

## Team roles and seats

Every write request runs with the role of the member who owns the API key or authorized the app. A role that does not allow an action gets **403** `FORBIDDEN` (or `APPROVAL_REQUIRED` when the post must go through approval instead). When a workspace has more members than its plan includes (for example after a downgrade), the members who joined most recently beyond the plan's seats are read-only: their write requests get **403** `SEAT_LIMIT` until the owner upgrades or frees a seat. The owner always keeps full access, and removing a member or leaving still work.

Account metrics with channel list.

`engagementRate` on each row is ALWAYS `null`: no platform handler computes an account-level engagement rate (the `getAccountAnalytics` contract has no such field), so the stored column is its default 0 for every row. It is returned as null rather than 0 so it cannot be mistaken for a measured 0%. For a real rate, use the per-post `engagementRate` inside `platformMetrics[]` on `GET /api/analytics/engagement`.

`websiteClicks` is populated by Google Business only; `profileViews` by Facebook only (`page_views_total`). Both are 0 for every other platform because no other handler reports them — not because the value was measured as zero.

200.description:
Engagement data including totalImpressions, totalReach, totalLikes, totalComments, totalShares, totalSaves, totalClicks, totalVideoViews, avgEngagementRate, byPlatform, byDay, topPosts, allPosts, and unmeasuredPlatforms.

`unmeasuredPlatforms` lists platforms present in the window that cannot report per-post metrics at all — either the platform has no readable metrics API (Google Business, Telegram, Tumblr) or, for LinkedIn, the channel is a personal/profile account (share statistics are exposed only for organization pages). Their rows still appear in every total with zeroes, so a zero for one of these platforms means "not reported", not "measured zero". Each entry in a post's `platformMetrics` carries the same signal as `metricsSupported`, which is also `false` (with `supportedMetrics` reduced to `linkClicks`) for an X post that has no snapshot because its channel has not opted into metrics sync.

All figures come from the stored `post_metrics` snapshot, synced every 6 hours (or on demand via `POST /api/analytics/refresh`) — not a live read of the platform.

`metricSupport` maps each platform present in the window to the list of metric keys its API can actually report (`impressions`, `reach`, `likes`, `comments`, `shares`, `saves`, `clicks`, `videoViews`, `engagementRate`). Anything not listed is stored as 0 by the metrics sync because the platform has no such field — it is NOT a measurement. For example X reports impressions/likes/comments/shares/saves (bookmarks), so `reach`, `clicks` and `videoViews` are always 0 for X rows; Bluesky and Mastodon report no impressions, so `engagementRate` is always 0 for them; Pinterest reports no reach; YouTube reports no shares, reach or impressions (its views are `videoViews`), so it has no `engagementRate` and adds 0 to every `engagements` figure, because YouTube's API policies do not allow figures derived from its data; Discord reports likes (reaction counts) and comments (thread replies) only.

`supportedTotals` is the union of `metricSupport` across the window — the org-wide `total*` fields are only measurements for keys listed here. A key absent from `supportedTotals` should be rendered as “not available” (a dash), never as 0. `partialTotals` maps a supported metric key to the platforms in the window that do NOT report it, so a consumer can note that the total covers only a subset of posts.

Each entry of a post's `platformMetrics` also carries `supportedMetrics` (same per-platform list) alongside `metricsSupported`. `supportedMetrics` can also depend on the post type: an Instagram story lists only `impressions`, `reach`, `comments` (story replies) and `engagementRate`, because story insights have no likes, saves or shares.

Facebook's `impressions`, `reach`, `clicks` and `engagementRate` come from the Page Insights edge and require the `read_insights` permission; without it they stay 0 even though the metric is listed as supported.

`metricsDisabledChannels` lists channels published to in the window whose metrics sync is switched off, so their posts contribute zeroes to every total. X is the only platform this applies to today: its reads are billed, so per-post metrics sync is opt-in per channel (`metadata.metricsSyncEnabled`, toggled on the Channels page) and runs at most once every 7 days. `POST /api/analytics/refresh` will not produce X figures for a channel that has not opted in.

`conditionalMetrics` maps a platform in the window to metrics that are supported but permission-gated — a 0 there means "may not be readable", not "no such metric". Today Facebook appears for `impressions`, `reach`, `clicks` and `engagementRate`, and TikTok for `reach`, `saves` and `clicks`, which only accounts that have granted TikTok insights report.

A platform may also expose `variants` — sub-platforms gated separately because the vendor reviews them as a separate app. LinkedIn reports `variants.organization` for company pages; personal-profile availability is the platform-level state.

post.description:
Create a new post as draft or scheduled. Validates character limits per platform, media ownership, channel ownership, and plan quotas.

**Character limits:** X: 280, Bluesky: 300, Threads: 500, Mastodon: 500, Pinterest: 500, GMB: 1500, Instagram: 2200, TikTok: 2200, LinkedIn: 3000, YouTube: 5000, Facebook: 63206. On X and Mastodon every URL counts as a flat 23 characters (t.co wrapping / Mastodon link counting), regardless of its real length.

**Link cards:** for a text-only post (no media) containing a URL, the first URL is unfurled at publish time. Facebook receives it as the `link` param, Bluesky as an external embed (with thumbnail), and LinkedIn as a `content.article` card (LinkedIn's API never scrapes URLs itself; if the page yields no title, the post publishes as plain text without a card). Other platforms unfurl the URL themselves or render it as plain text (links in Instagram/TikTok captions are not clickable).

Returns **403** with `code: "PLATFORM_DISABLED"` when a target channel's platform has been switched off server-side (`PLATFORM_<NAME>=off`). This is distinct from `FEATURE_DISABLED`, which means the platform is not on the organization's plan. Check `GET /api/platforms` for current availability. A channel's *variant* can be off on its own — LinkedIn company pages are gated separately from personal profiles — in which case the error also carries `accountType` (e.g. `"organization"`) naming the variant that is unavailable. Requires a role that can edit posts (owner, admin, approver, contributor); viewers get 403 FORBIDDEN.

autoPlugEnabled.description: Optional. Auto-post a comment when the post reaches a like threshold

autoPlugText.description: Optional. The promotional comment text for auto-plug

autoPlugThreshold.description: Optional. Number of likes to trigger auto-plug (default: 50). Whole number from 0 to 2147483647; outside that range the request is rejected.

autoRepostEnabled.description: Optional. Auto-repost/reshare when the post reaches a like threshold

autoRepostThreshold.description: Optional. Number of likes to trigger auto-repost (default: 100). Whole number from 0 to 2147483647; outside that range the request is rejected.

channels.description: Required. Target channels to publish to

platform.description: Platform name. Optional — the server always resolves the platform from the channel record; a supplied value is ignored.

content.description: Post text content (optional if media attached). LinkedIn mentions: write @[Display Name](urn:li:organization:ID) to mention a Page or @[Display Name](urn:li:person:ID) to mention a person; the token publishes as a real mention on LinkedIn and as plain @Display Name on every other channel of the same post, and counts as @Display Name toward every character limit. GET /api/channels/{id}/mentions?q=<vanity-name> on a LinkedIn channel returns ready-made tokens for Pages (exact match on the Page's URL slug; a personal channel borrows a connected Page's access for the lookup). Reserved LinkedIn formatting characters in the rest of the text are escaped for you at publish time, so send plain text and never pre-escape it yourself.

deleteMediaAfterPublish.description: Optional. Delete uploaded media right after publishing (default: false — media is kept and reclaimed by the 3-month retention sweep). When true, the original is removed once every channel has published and stops counting toward your media storage limit. Forced to false when the post has a repeatSchedule.

linkTrackingOverride.description: Per-post override for link tracking (bulkpubli.sh). `true` forces links in this post to be shortened and their clicks counted, `false` forces them to publish as written, and `null` (the default) inherits the organization's Link Tracking setting. Shortening happens at publish time, per channel, so two accounts on the same platform get distinct codes; it is skipped for a channel when the rewrite would push the post past that platform's character limit. Short links are part of the Pro and Business plans: on Free, links always publish as written and `true` has no effect.

mediaFiles.description: Optional. Media file IDs from POST /api/media

platformContent.description: Optional. Per-platform content overrides mapping platform name to a plain string, e.g. { "x": "Short version" }. Values must be strings — nested objects are rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

platformThreadParts.description: Optional. Per-platform thread overrides, e.g. { "x": [{ "content": "Part 1" }] }. Part content must be a plain string — non-string shapes are rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

postTypeOverrides.description: Optional. Per-platform post type override. E.g. { "instagram": "reel", "facebook": "story" }. A type the platform does not offer is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (previously it silently fell back to the platform default). Instagram: feed_photo, feed_video, reel, story, carousel. Facebook: post, reel, story. TikTok: video, photo_slideshow. YouTube: video, short. LinkedIn: post, multi_image, pdf_carousel, article, document, poll, reshare. Pinterest: pin, video_pin, carousel. GMB: standard, event, offer. Snapchat: story, saved_story, spotlight. Video length is checked against each platform's documented range for the chosen type, and a video outside it is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when the post is scheduled or published: Instagram reel and feed_video 3–900s, story 3–60s; Facebook reel 3–90s, story 3–60s; Threads video and carousel up to 300s; LinkedIn 3–1800s; Pinterest video_pin at least 4s; Snapchat story 5–60s, spotlight 6–60s. Other types and platforms are not length-checked. LinkedIn post types: `post` (text, one image or one video), `multi_image` (2 to 20 images), `pdf_carousel` (2 to 20 images shown as a swipeable carousel), `article` (a link with preview), `document` (one PDF, Word or PowerPoint file of up to 100MB and 300 pages, shown in the feed as a document people page through; needs exactly one document in `mediaIds` and no images or videos; title from `platformSpecific.linkedin.documentTitle`), `poll` (a question with 2 to 4 answers from `platformSpecific.linkedin.poll`; needs post text; takes no media) and `reshare` (shares an existing LinkedIn post from `platformSpecific.linkedin.reshareId`; post text is optional and is published alongside it; takes no media). A document can only be published to LinkedIn, as a `document` post: a post that carries a document and targets any other platform, or a LinkedIn post type other than `document`, is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when it is scheduled or published (a draft may hold one). `repost` (X, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon) reposts an existing post at the scheduled time: the post's own text and media are ignored and `platformSpecific.<platform>.repostId` must hold the target (X: status URL or ID; Mastodon: status URL or ID; Bluesky: bsky.app post URL or at:// URI; Threads: the numeric post ID; Threads links cannot be used, and for posts published through BulkPublish the ID is in the post details). A missing or unparsable target is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR. This post type is available through the API only; the composer in the app does not offer it.

publishWhenApproved.description: Optional. Set true on a post that waits for approval when it should go out as soon as it is approved, even if that is after its scheduled time (the "publish now" of someone who needs approval: schedule it for now, with requestApproval or a contributor role, and send this). It decides what an approval that arrives more than 15 minutes after the scheduled time does: true publishes it immediately; false (the default) approves it but returns it to draft for a new time. An approver can override either way with whenLate on POST /api/posts/{id}/approve. Stored only when the post ends up with approvalStatus 'pending'; otherwise it is saved as false. Must be a boolean (400 VALIDATION_ERROR otherwise).

threadParts.description: Optional. Required when postFormat is 'thread' (min 2 parts)

403.description: Platform not on the plan (`FEATURE_DISABLED`) or switched off server-side (`PLATFORM_DISABLED`)

Requires a role that can edit posts (owner, admin, approver, contributor); viewers get 403 FORBIDDEN. `reschedule` applies the same scheduling limits as creating a scheduled post: drafts it moves into the queue count against the pending-scheduled limit, and posts it moves onto a day count against that day's limit (counted in the posts' own timezone; posts already on that day are not counted twice). Over a limit, nothing is changed and it returns 403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED. An unparseable `scheduledAt` returns 400. `postIds` takes at most 100 posts per request; send more in batches.
